title: 9 永生难忘一幕10 乱世父女
content_zh:
他往前走了一步，两步。
三步！
第三步落下时，脚掌踩实地面。
“砰！”
一声暴鸣。
不是脚步声，是脚掌发力时，那股力量作用在地面上，硬生生挤开了空气。
周娘子本能地去数第四步，但第四步没有落下。
紧接着，曹笔消失了。
原地只剩下一圈被踏裂的浮土，和一声闷响的尾音。
她耳朵轰的一声，被震得愣了一下。
就那么一愣神的功夫，她的目光下意识投向那群匪徒，
然后，她看见了这辈子都忘不掉的一幕。
最前面的十几个匪徒，还保持着刚才的姿态。
独眼汉子扛着刀，嘴咧着，在笑。
瘦高个叉着腰，歪着头，还在说着什么。
他们身后的那些人，有的举着刀，有的张着嘴，有的正往前迈步。
但全部定住了，一动不动。
像被施了定身咒，又像时间在他们身上停住了。
周娘子的瞳孔猛然收缩。
就在这时，那些僵住的身体，开始动了。

但不是他们自己在动，是他们的头。
十几颗头，齐齐从脖子上滑落。
没有血喷出来。
没有惨叫。
就那么滑落，像熟透的果子从枝头坠落。
一颗。
两颗。
三颗。
噗、噗、噗……砸在泥土里，滚了两圈，停下。
那些无头的身体，还站着。
脖子上的切口整齐得不像被刀砍的，像是被什么极细极快的东西划过，连血都没来得及流。
然后是后面的。
那些刚反应过来，脸上刚露出惊恐，嘴里刚想喊出什么的人，他们的头也开始滑落。
一颗。
两颗。
三颗。
十几颗。
又是十几颗。
所有的头，全在地上。
所有的身体，全站着。

风吹过官道，吹动那些无头尸体的衣角，吹动他们背上的箭羽，吹动地上的尘土。
血终于涌出来了！
content_en:
He took one step forward, then two steps.
Three steps!
When falling in the third step, the soles of your feet touch the ground.
"Bang!"
A loud roar.
It wasn't the sound of footsteps, it was the force acting on the ground when the soles of the feet exerted force, forcefully squeezing out the air.
Mrs. Zhou instinctively counted the fourth step, but she missed the fourth step.
Immediately afterwards, Cao Bi disappeared.
All that was left was a circle of broken soil and a muffled tail sound.
There was a bang in her ears and she was stunned for a moment.
For a moment, she was stunned, and her eyes subconsciously turned to the group of gangsters.
Then, she saw a scene she would never forget in her life.
The dozen gangsters at the front still maintained their previous posture.
The one-eyed man was holding the knife, grinning.
The tall and thin man had his hands on his hips, tilted his head, and was still talking.
Some of the people behind them were holding knives, some had their mouths open, and some were walking forward.
But they were all frozen, motionless.
It was like a restraining spell had been cast on them, and it was like time had stopped on them.
Madam Zhou's pupils suddenly contracted.
At this moment, those frozen bodies began to move.
But it's not them who are moving, it's their heads.
More than a dozen heads all slipped off the neck.
No blood spurted out.
No screams.
It just slipped, like a ripe fruit falling from a branch.
One.
Two.
Three.
Puff, puff, puff... it hit the dirt, rolled twice, and stopped.
Those headless bodies are still standing.
The incision on the neck was so neat that it didn't look like it had been cut with a knife. It looked like it had been scratched by something very thin and very fast, without even having time to bleed.
And then there's the back.
Those who had just reacted, who had just shown panic on their faces, and who had just wanted to shout something, their heads began to slip.
One.
Two.
Three.
A dozen.
A dozen more.
All the heads are on the ground.
All bodies are standing.
The wind blew through the official road, blowing the clothes corners of the headless corpses, blowing the arrow feathers on their backs, and blowing the dust on the ground.
The blood finally gushes out!
